notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.12
notes.notes:
1. Fixed an issue where the score settlement interface in Dream Tower mode would display overlapping elements.
2. Fixed an issue where ability experience gained in Dream Tower could not be saved.
3. Fixed an issue where the girl’s outfit in Dream Tower was not resetting.
4. Fixed an issue where the girl would display overlapping in the ability settlement interface in Dream Tower.
5. In Dream Tower mode, cards that cause self-damage no longer prevent players from achieving the "Flawless" score item.
